categories.info: Each bobbleheads grants a unique, permanent perk. Craft a bobblehead stand to proudly display your collection!

categories.title: Fusion Core
categories.info: Fusion Cores are used to keep power armor running. In addition to their mapped locations, they have a random chance of appearing in containers like ammo boxes.

categories.title: Mini Nuke
categories.info: Mini Nukes are ammunition for the Fat Man, a **very** powerful weapon.

categories.title: Nuka Cherry
categories.info:
A refreshing cherry twist on the classic Nuka-Cola! Consume to receive:
- +50 HP
- +25 AP
- +5 Rads

categories.title: Nuka Quantum
categories.info:
Prepare yourself for a nuclear blast of flavor! Consume to receive:
- +400 HP
- +100 AP
- +5 Rads

categories.title: Stimpak
categories.info: Stimpaks are used to restore health. In addition to their mapped locations, they can be found randomly in containers like first aid kits.

categories.title: Brotherhood Quest
categories.info: Listed XP rewards are base values; your earned XP will differ based on stats, perks, etc.

categories.title: Radiant Quest
categories.info:
Radiant quests are randomly generated, repeatable quests from the Commonwealth's various factions. 

If you want to prevent radiant quests from infinitely restarting, complete the quest then never return to the quest-giving NPC.
